statement: Dolphin dispatches Wii speaker-enable output report 0x14 and speaker-mute 0x19 as one-byte control payloads: bit 0 carries the shared rumble state, bit 1 requests an ACK, and bit 2 carries the enable/mute state. Speaker-data report 0x18 uses payload-control byte bit 0 for rumble, bits 3-7 for a five-bit encoded-data length of at most 20 bytes, and a separate 20-byte data area; bits 1-2 are not assigned semantics by the cited report struct. The emulated controller conditionally acknowledges 0x14/0x19, ignores oversized speaker payloads, and routes accepted 0x18 bytes into the speaker I2C slave at data offset 0. Dolphin documents unresolved exceptions where speaker-data reports may receive errors under rapid sending. Register setup arrives as ordinary memory writes through output 0x16, not a distinct audio report; real passthrough relays these writes without interpreting speaker registers.

applicability.scope: EmuSubroutines.cpp 90-125, 362-399; WiimoteReport.h 68-78, 149-159; WiimoteReal.cpp 260-291. Report roles align with wii-gap-wiibrew-speaker-control-reports, although exact hardware ACK/overrun behavior remains unverified.
